# Comment-rule violations that predate TestCommentsStayTerse.
#
# One line per file and rule: "<file> <rule> <count>", sorted. <file> is
# relative to the repository root. <rule> is dash, filler, deliberately,
# matters, history or length. <count> is the number of occurrences (for
# length, the number of blocks over the line budget).
#
# The test requires each count to match the file exactly. A new violation
# fails it, and so does a count that has dropped or an entry with no
# violation left, so a change that fixes comments lowers or deletes the
# lines it fixed. Never add a line or raise a count: fix the comment.
